content.class.carter.blurb: 你赶车运货，常走这道隘口。身上一件外套，一把割绳的刀，几块路上吃的面包。
content.class.carter.kit.0.name: 车夫的外套
content.class.carter.kit.1.name: 割绳刀
content.class.carter.name: 车夫
content.fx.the-toll-road.oc.raise-the-bar.3.narr: 链条吃住重量，横杆从路面上抬起。
content.fx.trig.toll-bell.1.narrate: 踏板下陷，墙内铃声响起。这条路上每一步，守卫都听得见。
content.loot.booth-barrel.item.0.name: 守卫之盾
content.loot.booth-barrel.item.1.name: 收费价目表
content.obj.the-toll-road.raise-the-bar.hint: 绞盘杆立在隘口顶端的收费横杆旁。
content.obj.the-toll-road.raise-the-bar.title: 升起收费横杆
content.obj.the-toll-road.through-the-gap.hint: 道路越过升起的横杆继续向前。
content.obj.the-toll-road.through-the-gap.title: 穿过隘口
content.quest.the-toll-road.goal: 沿着哈罗隘口走到收费横杆，升起它，然后穿过去；墙上的库房只要你能识破机关，就任你劫掠。
content.world.outro: 收费横杆立在哈罗隘口顶端，路继续向前伸进山谷。已经很久没人在这隘口交过钱了，今天也没有人交。
content.world.title: 收费古道

source.class.carter.blurb: You drive goods through the gap. A coat, a knife for rope, and bread for the road.
source.class.carter.kit.0.name: Carter's Coat
source.class.carter.kit.1.name: Rope Knife
source.class.carter.name: Carter
source.fx.the-toll-road.oc.raise-the-bar.3.narr: The chain takes the weight, and the bar swings up out of the road.
source.fx.trig.toll-bell.1.narrate: The plate sinks, and a bell rings in the wall. The wardens heard every step on this road.
source.loot.booth-barrel.item.0.name: Warden's Shield
source.loot.booth-barrel.item.1.name: Toll Schedule
source.obj.the-toll-road.raise-the-bar.hint: The winch lever stands beside the toll bar at the head of the pass.
source.obj.the-toll-road.raise-the-bar.title: Raise the toll bar
source.obj.the-toll-road.through-the-gap.hint: The road runs on past the raised bar.
source.obj.the-toll-road.through-the-gap.title: Go through the gap
source.quest.the-toll-road.goal: Walk Harrow Gap to the toll bar, raise it, and go through; the strongrooms in the walls are yours to rob if you can read their traps.
source.world.outro: The toll bar stands up at the head of Harrow Gap, and the road runs on into the valley. Nobody has paid at the gap for a long time, and today nobody did.
source.world.title: The Toll Road
